# HCEA Limited (Hong-Kong Consulting Engineering Asia)

> Engineering and consulting support in Asia (China, Pearl River Delta) since 2008 — a local contact point in Hong Kong.

## Who we are
HCEA Limited ("Hong-Kong Consulting Engineering Asia") is a Hong-Kong based engineering and consulting firm (14/F, 185 Wanchai Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong; +852 2571 3313; contact@hcea.asia). It accompanies European and international clients through the research, development and maintenance phases of investment projects in Asia, with a local presence in the Pan Pearl River Delta (8 provinces of Guangdong, ~490M inhabitants). Sister company: Energy Stock Alliance (ESA, energy-stock.com, Andorra).

## Services
- Solar energy & photovoltaic panels, information technology (PHP, MySQL, Documentum, Java), raw materials.
- Industrial engineering (mechanical, oil & gas) — studies, development, maintenance.
- Real property and industrial establishment in Asia.
- HCEA Strategic Marketing: strategy, branding, advertising, SEO/SEM, campaigns.

## Value proposition
- Risk reduction for an establishment in Asia: cost reduction, time savings, no weary Europe–Asia round trips.
- Tailor-made services, carried out in the strictest confidentiality.
- On-site assistance in 1–12 hours depending on client location.
